text:
Priya: Hey team — last-minute favor. Flying out Wed morning and I can't cover the Wed swing shift (3pm–11pm PT). There's a canary rollout scheduled at 5pm for model v1.2.2 (manual start). Low risk but please follow the runbook. Willing to swap for Fri morning or cover another shift later. Anyone able to pick up or trade?

Sam: I can take it if there aren't any infra-heavy tasks. Quick Qs: is the canary auto or manual? Also where's the warmup checklist?

oncall-bot: Scheduled rollout: model-v1.2.2 canary starts 2024-11-20 17:00 PT. Expected duration ~1h. Pager thresholds unchanged.

Priya: Thanks @Sam. Canary is manual — someone needs to trigger at 17:00 PT. Prechecks required. Quick runbook snippet: ```shell
# quick health check
curl -s https://status.internal/health | jq .tokens_inflight
# ensure < 500
``` Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/canary-v1.2.2
Also pre-warm: trigger 10m before with small batch of requests to prime KV cache.

Alex: I can cover 3–7pm and hand off to whoever covers 7–11pm. FYI there's a short maintenance window at ~6:30 that may bump p99; watch svc-infer-prod p99 and GPU memory. If you take the whole shift, remember cache-priming after deploy.

Jamie: I can shadow first 30m then need to leave for an all-hands. If Alex does 3–7 and someone covers 7–11 that works. @Priya can you add post-handoff notes to the pinned doc?

Sam: Ok, I can do 7–11 if Alex takes 3–7. If no one else, I can stretch to full 3–11 but prefer the split. @Priya please add token thresholds and fallback model id to the handoff.

Priya: Added thresholds to the pinned doc and DM'ed the fallback model id. Handoff notes (brief): prechecks ✅, session cookie: infer-session-dev, escalate to infra if GPU memory > 92% for > 5m, rollback id location: deployment page -> history. Thanks so much everyone :heart:

Alex: 👍 I'll take 3–7. Will ping Sam at 18:50 PT to transfer keys and quick status. Leaving a short note in #eng-oncall-handbook.

oncall-bot: Reminder: rollback procedure requires 'rollback_id' from the deployment page. Use `/deploy status model-v1.2.2` to fetch.

Jamie: :thumbsup: Good luck, team.
